name: VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026
short_description: A road race in Hải Phòng, Vietnam, on 27 December 2026, over 5 km to 42.195 km, starting on Trần Hưng Đạo street in the city centre, with the marathon finishing in Đồ Sơn.
ai_summary: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is a road race scheduled for Sunday 27 December 2026 in Hải Phòng, Vietnam, its fourth edition. Organised by VnExpress and FPT Online, it offers four distances: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. In 2025 all four started on Trần Hưng Đạo street in central Hải Phòng; the marathon ran out along the coast road to finish in Đồ Sơn, while the shorter races finished back on Trần Hưng Đạo.

core_facts.venue: Trần Hưng Đạo street, central Hải Phòng (start); marathon finish in Đồ Sơn

pros: Flat, straight course with 134 sub-three-hour finishers in 2025
Early start and a December date keep it cooler than most Southeast Asian marathons
22 aid stations on the marathon, denser in the second half
Organiser buses bring marathon finishers back from Do Son
cons: Six-hour marathon limit with four checkpoints needs about 8:30 per km from the gun
2025 was 19°C and 94% humidity at the start, not the cold race of its reputation
Open coast road to Do Son can be windy in late December
Coast roads use a separate lane rather than full closure

faqs.question: When is the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026?
faqs.answer: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is on Sunday 27 December 2026 and is the race's fourth edition. In 2025 every distance started on Trần Hưng Đạo street in central Hải Phòng before dawn, with the marathon at 2.30am and the half marathon at 3.30am. The marathon finished in Đồ Sơn, and organiser buses brought runners back.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distance options at the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race, allowing participants of varying experience levels and fitness to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Who organises the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is organised by VnExpress, a Vietnamese news outlet, and FPT Online, which also run the other VnExpress Marathon races. In 2025 the Hải Phòng race was the last of that year's VnExpress Marathon series, and the organiser reported more than 14,000 runners. The 2025 route maps carried a World Athletics and AIMS certified-course badge.
